title: Conditional Sentences: Introduction

## Conditional Sentences: Introduction

Understand the conditional clause and the main clause.

### Lesson focus

1. If it rains, we shall get wet.
2. The conditional clause begins with if, when, as soon as, till, until, unless, provided that, except that or in case.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
